title: . Application fees
text:
19.37.070. Application fees.
A.	Every application shall be accompanied by the prescribed fees in the amounts established and set forth in the annual budget resolution of the city or other appropriate fee schedule prepared and adopted by the city council. The prescribed fees shall not be refundable and shall be submitted no later than the date an application is determined to be complete. The fee schedule may be amended from time to time by resolution of the city council.
B.	Reserved.
(Ord. 16882 § 2(part), 2008; Ord. No. 17236, § 18, 11-10-2009; Ord. No. 19243, § 19, 10-12-2021)
